ask.title: Ask a question
ask.subtitle: Show your thinking so far — tutors and classmates can help faster with more context.
ask.noScopeOptions: You're not currently enrolled in a course, so there's nowhere to post a question yet. Ask your tutor or an administrator to check your enrollment.
ask.templateLabel: What kind of question is this?

concept_explanation.label: Explain a concept
concept_explanation.description: You want to understand why something works, not just the steps.

homework_help.label: Homework help
homework_help.description: You're stuck on a specific problem and want a nudge, not the answer.

check_my_solution.label: Check my solution
check_my_solution.description: You solved it and want someone to confirm your work.

alternative_method.label: Alternative method
alternative_method.description: You got an answer, but want to see a different way to solve it.

exam_preparation.label: Exam preparation
exam_preparation.description: You're reviewing for a test and want to practice or clarify a topic.

proof_review.label: Proof review
proof_review.description: You wrote a proof and want feedback on its rigor.

general_discussion.label: General discussion
general_discussion.description: Anything else math-related you'd like to talk through.

overview.title: Ask where your learning happens.
overview.intro: Questions stay inside your course, group, or subject. Your tutor can review replies and mark a verified answer.

scope.title: Scoped, not searchable
scope.body: Choose a course, group, or subject. Learning Questions are not public and never appear in search engines.

identity.title: Names stay minimal
identity.body: Posts use your first name and a platform identifier. Anonymous posts are not available.

review.title: Answers are reviewed
review.body: Student answers are shown as unverified until a tutor verifies them.

sample.label: Example question
sample.title: Why does the denominator stay the same?
sample.answer: I think we are counting equal parts, so the denominator tells us the size of the parts.
sample.tutorAnswer: That is the right starting point. The denominator names the equal-sized parts; adding fractions combines the number of those parts.

overview.safety: Files are checked before anyone can open them. Avoid sharing contact details, addresses, or IDs; those posts are flagged for review.
overview.sla: Tutor response target: within 12 service hours on service days. This is a visible target, not a live guarantee.
overview.noDm: Need help with a question? Keep it here—Learning Questions does not offer private messaging.
